verified_facts.text: Every room and suite at The Lanesborough has dedicated round-the-clock butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: With round-the-clock, dedicated butler service offered in every room and suite

verified_facts.text: The Lanesborough Grill serves modern British dining by Executive Chef Shay Cooper.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lanesborough Grill, with modern British dining by Executive Chef Shay Cooper

verified_facts.text: The hotel's cigar lounge is The Garden Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: one of London's best cigar lounges, The Garden Room

verified_facts.text: The Lanesborough Club & Spa is a health and fitness destination open to members and hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Lanesborough Club & Spa was unveiled, a prestigious health and fitness destination open to members and hotel guests

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are each individually designed with Regency interiors and responsive technology.
verified_facts.excerpt: are each individually designed with luxurious Regency interiors and responsive technology

verified_facts.text: The hotel's food and drink venues include the Library Bar, the Garden Room terrace, the Withdrawing Room and The Lanesborough Grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the vibrant Library Bar to the sunny Garden Room terrace, the stately Withdrawing Room to The Lanesborough Grill

verified_facts.text: Le Cafe LPM, an interpretation of the La Petite Maison spirit, has debuted at The Lanesborough.
verified_facts.excerpt: A fresh interpretation of the celebrated La Petite Maison spirit debuts at The Lanesborough.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has new balcony rooms and terrace suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover London from a new perspective in our new balcony rooms and terrace suites.

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs events including live music, seasonal menus, cigar masterclasses and wine dinners.
verified_facts.excerpt: including live music, seasonal menus, cigar masterclasses, wine dinners and more

verified_facts.text: Anglo-Irish nobleman James Lane built a hunting-lodge-cum-country mansion on the site and lived there until his death in 1779.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was here that Anglo-Irish nobleman James Lane built his hunting-lodge-cum-country mansion, where he resided until his death in 1779.

verified_facts.text: The building was rebuilt in 1825 as St George's Hospital by architect William Wilkins, who designed London's National Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: the state-of-the-art St George's Hospital, rebuilt in 1825 by architect William Wilkins, the mind behind London’s National Gallery

verified_facts.text: The Regency-era building became a luxury hotel in 1991.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its final transformation came in 1991, when the grand Regency-era structure was reborn as a luxury hotel

verified_facts.text: A 2014 restoration involved more than 300 plasterers, embroiderers, crystal specialists and other artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: followed by a lavish 2014 restoration involving more than 300 plasterers, embroiderers, and crystal specialists, among other artisans

verified_facts.text: More than 42,000 gold leaf sheets were used for the gilding on the ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: more than 42,000 gold leaf sheets were used for the gilding on the ceilings alone

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been part of the Oetker Collection since 2015.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 2015, the hotel has been a jewel of the Oetker Collection

verified_facts.text: Butler service can be summoned from an in-room iPad that also controls lighting and curtains.
verified_facts.excerpt: summonable at the tap of an iPad that also controls lighting, curtains, and more

verified_facts.text: The Lanesborough Grill sits beneath a glass dome.
verified_facts.excerpt: set beneath a soaring glass dome and anchored by crystal chandeliers, stately columns, and tasseled baby-blue banquettes

verified_facts.text: The Library Bar is known for its fine whiskies and cognacs, some dating back to 1770.
verified_facts.excerpt: celebrated for its trove of fine whiskies and cognacs, some dating back to 1770

verified_facts.text: The spa has saunas, steam rooms, rain showers, a hydrotherapy pool and treatment suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: saunas, steam rooms, rain showers, a hydrotherapy pool, and serene treatment suites

verified_facts.text: The fitness center offers daily small-group classes including HIIT, boxing, TRX conditioning and reformer Pilates.
verified_facts.excerpt: daily small-group classes span HIIT, boxing, TRX conditioning, and reformer Pilates

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits at Hyde Park Corner, within easy reach of Buckingham Palace, Harrods, the Victoria and Albert Museum and the Natural History Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: rising grandly above Hyde Park Corner and placing guests within easy reach of Buckingham Palace, Harrods, and cultural heavyweights like the Serpentine Galleries, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the Natural History Museum

verified_facts.text: The Little VIP Club offers family experiences including mocktail-making classes, horseback riding and carriage rides through Hyde Park, and in-room treasure hunts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Little VIP Club, a thoughtfully curated program of family-friendly experiences that includes mocktail-making classes, horseback riding and carriage rides through Hyde Park, in-room treasure hunts

verified_facts.text: At the Little Butler Bootcamp, children learn to brew tea or set a table.
verified_facts.excerpt: Little Butler Bootcamp, where children learn how to brew the perfect cup of tea or set a table to royal standards

verified_facts.text: Some ground-floor rooms are wheelchair accessible, with adapted bathrooms and roll-in shower cubicles.
verified_facts.excerpt: A selection of ground-floor, wheelchair-accessible rooms are equipped with emergency alarm systems and adapted bathrooms featuring raised toilets, grab rails, adjustable showerheads, and roll-in shower cubicles.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a resident Siberian Forest cat named Lilibet, after Queen Elizabeth II.
verified_facts.excerpt: resident Siberian Forest cat, Lilibet — named after Queen Elizabeth II
